pages.lesson:
LESSON: TAWBAH

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.2: Tawbah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Tawbah. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should a Muslim seek repentance from Allah (S.W.T.)?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. state the conditions of tawbah as a basis for forgiveness from Allah (S.W.T.)
2. practise actions that lead to tawbah as a way of purifying one from sins

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. state the conditions of tawbah as a basis for forgiveness from Allah (S.W.T.)
   In simple words: practise until you can state the conditions of tawbah as a basis for forgiveness from Allah (S.W.T.). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. practise actions that lead to tawbah as a way of purifying one from sins
   In simple words: practise until you can practise actions that lead to tawbah as a way of purifying one from sins. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Tawbah using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Tawbah in the examples.
2. Explain Tawbah to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Tawbah.
4. Show that you can: state the conditions of tawbah as a basis for forgiveness from Allah (S.W.T.)

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Tawbah using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Tawbah important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the significance of tawbah (Q25:70, Q39:53) in pairs/groups and make a class presentation,
2. Digital Literacy enhanced as learners search for the Hadith on tawbah online
3. Communication and Collaboration enhanced as learners discuss the significance of tawbah (Q25:70, Q39:53) and make class presentations

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should a Muslim seek repentance from Allah (S.W.T.)?
2. How should Muslims seek repentance from Allah (S.W.T.)?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. state the conditions of tawbah as a basis for forgiveness from Allah (S.W.T.)
2. practise actions that lead to tawbah as a way of purifying one from sins

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
